title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Why Diversification Protects You

questions.text: What does diversification help protect against?
questions.explanation: Diversification reduces the impact of a single stock's poor performance on the overall portfolio.

questions.text: True or false: Spreading investments across different sectors and asset types can reduce the impact of a downturn in any one area.
questions.explanation: Spreading investments across different sectors and asset types cushions the portfolio when one investment drops.
